Requirement: All fees must be displayed to the consumer at the point of ticket selection before any account creation or queue entry
Acceptance Criterion: Consumer sees full all-in price within 2 clicks of selecting a ticket. No fees revealed for the first time at checkout.

Requirement: Each fee must be individually itemised and labelled in plain language with a one-sentence explanation of what it covers
Acceptance Criterion: Service fee, facility fee, order processing fee, and delivery fee each display with a tooltip or label explaining the charge

Requirement: Platforms must display the all-in price in all search results and event listing pages alongside the face value
Acceptance Criterion: Search results show both face value and total price including all fees before the consumer clicks into an event

Requirement: Resale tickets must not be listed above original face value as set by the event organiser
Acceptance Criterion: Platform rejects any resale listing above verified face value. Face value verified against original ticket issuance record.
Status: Implemented on Ticketmaster and StubHub Canada

Requirement: Platforms must provide a full fee breakdown in the order confirmation email matching exactly what was displayed at checkout
Acceptance Criterion: Confirmation email contains line-by-line fee detail. No fee may appear in the email that was not disclosed at checkout.

Requirement: Digital ticket delivery must not be charged as a separate fee when no physical item is being produced or shipped
Acceptance Criterion: PDF and mobile wallet delivery are included in the base transaction. Delivery fee only permitted for physical mail delivery.

Requirement: Platforms must report quarterly fee revenue data to the Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission or designated regulator
Acceptance Criterion: Quarterly report submitted within 30 days of quarter end including total fee revenue by fee type and average fee per transaction

Requirement: Consumers must be able to opt out of non-essential fees such as ticket insurance at the point of selection not as a pre-checked default
Acceptance Criterion: Ticket insurance and add-on products default to deselected. Consumer must actively opt in.

Requirement: High demand events triggering virtual queues must display the all-in price before the consumer joins the queue
Acceptance Criterion: Queue entry page shows estimated total price including all fees. Consumer confirmed price-aware before wait begins.

Requirement: Platforms must provide a price comparison tool showing the same event listed across multiple authorised sellers
Acceptance Criterion: Consumer can view all authorised sellers for an event and their all-in prices on a single comparison screen

Requirement: Platforms must publish an annual consumer fee report showing average fees charged by event category and venue
Acceptance Criterion: Annual report published on platform website by January 31 each year covering the prior calendar year

Requirement: Venues must disclose their facility fee calculation methodology to the designated regulator upon request
Acceptance Criterion: Methodology document submitted within 14 days of regulator request

Requirement: Platforms must offer a full refund including all fees for any event cancelled by the organiser within 7 business days
Acceptance Criterion: Refund processed within 7 business days for cancellations. All fees refunded not just face value.

Requirement: Mobile-only ticket delivery platforms must provide an accessible alternative for consumers without smartphones
Acceptance Criterion: At least one non-mobile delivery option available for all events at no additional charge

Requirement: Platforms must notify consumers by email or push notification when the all-in price for a saved event drops below a threshold set by the consumer
Acceptance Criterion: Price alert system available for all logged-in consumers with configurable threshold
